6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.39973 of 2023(5) dt.15-02-2024 of the case as well as the allegation being general and omnibus, let the above named petitioner, in the event of his arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court concerned, Katihar in connection with Katihar (Town) P.S. 7.
